sample_source: First 100 rows of the existing paired Gaussian sample bank, first 200 observations per row
brent_objective: Shared analytic Gaussian Q_0 objective; pair distances prepared inside each call; endpoints compared
timing: One fresh call per method and sample, 100 timed calls per method; mean across all 100. Method order randomized separately for each sample. All methods initialized once before timing. No sample-specific matrix or objective cache is shared between timed calls.
